findings.description: AWS access-key credentials are embedded in the Lambda environment variables and therefore in Terraform configuration/state; Lambda environment configuration can also be read by principals with function-configuration access. These long-lived credentials should be removed, rotated if real, and replaced with the Lambda execution role and a managed secret mechanism where needed.
The function uses `nodejs12.x`, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Running unsupported code increases exposure to unpatched runtime vulnerabilities.
